experiment: Experiment 82.3.4 PS-DSFR — Prompt-guided Discriminative Spectral Feature Residual Learning
selection: Historical val=test. Strict test ACC improvement. Keep earliest tie.
preprocessing: Historical pre-CV RFE and scaling, transductive graph, train/test arrays unchanged.

class_statistics.estimation: Initialize with byte-exact E82.3 fit on legal E61 epoch10 training rows; explicit post-evaluation EMA follows below.

ema.compute: CPU float64 legal CAM projection using the original spectrum cache, then observed first and uncentered second moments.
ema.initialization: Start with E82.3 mean and stable inference variance exactly. Derive raw second moment from E82.3 unbiased variance times (n-1)/n plus squared mean.
ema.variance: Clamp roundoff in second minus mean squared at zero and apply n/(n-1) by class before E82.3 stabilization. Inference uses float32.
ema.order: Train, four optimizer steps, evaluate once and select Best with prior EMA, freeze Best if selected, update EMA once using captured legal eval CAM, persist post-update Latest.

feature_math.projection: Exact E82.2 canonical U. h=z@U transports the residual. hh=(z-mu)@U/sqrt(lambda+eps) supplies the historical Gaussian and token features.
feature_math.class_attention: A_c is union coverage over four class prompts. N_c is their mean null mass. C_c=(1-N_c)*A_c/(sum(A_c)+eps).
feature_math.discriminative_evidence: S=C_ASD-C_TD. E_c=C_c*R*sigmoid(LLR*tanh(16*S)). D=E_ASD-E_TD. The bounded LLR is positive for ASD.
feature_math.reliability: R=0.5+0.5*tanh(16*w_sp) using inherited spectral MLP over [abs(hh),loglambda,nu]. Common multipliers cannot create class difference or amplify C_ASD-C_TD.
feature_math.gate_and_residual: g=tanh(Linear16(GELU(Linear16([LN(z),D,R,N_ASD,N_TD])))); final affine starts at zero. delta=smooth_limit((g*D*h)@U.T,z).
feature_math.limit_regularization: Historical tanh(x)/x with analytic zero limit; exact CAM norm correction below historical eps and a subnormal guard. Float64 norms, float32 feature output.
feature_math.semantic_off: Replace D with zeros and remove both class null inputs from gate. No residual survives.

loss.semantic: Class-balanced NLL of the two normalized sums of class evidence, with eps pseudocounts. No separate inference head.
loss.gradient_protection: Auxiliary gradients update new parameters only. s=min(1,0.5*min_b ||g_cls,b||/(0.01||g_sem,b||+0.001||g_safe,b||+1e-12)); valid groups have nonzero weighted auxiliary norm. s=0 if none. DARG total gradient remains unrestricted.

decision.performance: Audited all ten folds; mean ACC > 92.1891 and BA >= 92.0294; AUC/SEN deltas vs independently aligned B0 respect floors; positive net patient corrections.
decision.mechanism: All ten folds demonstrate nonzero main gradient for prompt projections, spectral MLP and gate after a real update, nonzero semantic gradient to prompt, non-identical class evidence and nonzero Best residual; full vs residual-off positive net hard corrections over legal diagnostic patients.
decision.execute_g2: Only after the independent G1 audit passes and both G1 gates pass. G2 differs solely by fixed Query buffer.
decision.independent_medical_evidence: Requires paired G1 ACC > G2, BA >= G2 and positive patient net corrections versus independently trained G2. Fixed Best Query swap is descriptive.
decision.low_margin_diagnostic: Report m_residual_off < 2, and Spearman correlation against continuous m_residual_off; neither is used for training or selecting a checkpoint.
